svg.title: Scene 85: The whole engine on one map
svg.desc: Five frames build one map in three zones by distance: touch (centimetres), radio (metres) and the internet (anywhere), over two bands for cryptography and governance. 1, in the touch zone a payment terminal powers a card through its field and the two exchange commands and replies. 2, in the radio zone a small tag broadcasts a rotating key, a passer-by’s phone overhears it and sends a sealed report over the internet to a relay, which stores it without being able to read it; the owner’s phone fetches and opens it. 3, the owner standing nearby measures distance and direction to the tag with ultra-wideband, and a finder who touches the tag with an NFC phone sees a web page, not a location; NFC never reaches the relay. 4, the account service links the tag to one owner and decides who may fetch reports or share; these are permissions, not data. 5, two bands under the map: cryptography and its move to post-quantum algorithms, and privacy and governance.

the cloud by NFC; nothing finds a tag by

g.text: NFC: power and data by near field

text.tspan: Card cryptograms, rotating keys, sealed reports, signed
firmware — and the move to post-quantum algorithms.
Consent, alerts for the person a tag travels with, account
hygiene, policy and who is accountable.
